name: text-embedding-3-large
description: Most capable embedding model for search and retrieval tasks.
longDescription: text-embedding-3-large is OpenAI's most capable embedding model, generating 3072-dimensional embeddings. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on embedding benchmarks and supports dimension reduction for flexible cost/performance tradeoffs.

codeSnippets.label: Python
codeSnippets.code:
import openai

client = openai.OpenAI()
response = client.embeddings.create(
    model="text-embedding-3-large",
    input="Hello world"
)
print(response.data[0].embedding[:5])
